To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

i) a PUF array is proposed for on-die secure key generation, ii) it leverages hybrid delay/crosscoupled PUF circuit and temporal majority voting circuit to stabilize PUF bits, iii) it features soft dark bits for sequestration of unstable bits, iv) it exhibits high tolerance to voltage/temperature variation, v) in-situ aging is used to further improve stability, and vi) it consumes ultra-low energy.

we present the design, implementation and characterization of a PVT-tolerant, all-digital PPUF circuit that is capable of generating 100% stable device-specific keys with high entropy, while consuming ultra-low energy.
we have developed the world's smallest PUF circuit, which is PVT variation tolerant and consumes ultra-low energy for 100% reliable secure key generation.

the development of low-cost, low-power, PVT-variation tolerant, high-entropy, stable and secure PUF circuits that are robust against invasive attacks.
the design of a low-energy, low-cost and high-entropy secure PUF circuit for on-die secure key generation.
design of a PUF circuit for secure key generation that is robust against process variations, voltage and temperature variations, and invasive probing attacks.

a PUF is a circuit that can be used to generate unique keys for device authentication and secure data encryption.

we have developed an ultra-low energy PUF circuit for 22nm technology, that is robust against process, voltage and temperature variations.
we have designed a hybrid physically unclounable function circuit with 16 variation-impacted minimum-sized transistors that are cross-coupled to determine the resolution dynamics.

the PUF circuit is designed to operate with a high level of stability in the presence of process, voltage, and temperature variations.

the hybrid PUF circuit can tolerate a wide range of process, voltage, temperature variations and aging, resulting in 100% stable key generation for secure on-die authentication and data security applications.
